notes.title: What's next for Ninjapple ? March 2020
notes.content:
Hi everyone !

First, I would like to thank everyone who played Ninjapple. But let me tell you that this game is far from being over !

I had a lot of feedback during the first week of the release and I am taking every one of them into account !

So, the priority for this month update will be :

- Improve the player movements ( especially with the controller )
- Fix the issues regarding the Pause menu 
- Fix the issued regarding the overlapping musics 

But I will also add many features in the future ( probably not on this update ). 
Such as :

- New quests
- The "challenge mode" 


Lastly, I want to thank you one more time, and I hope you'll stick with us to find out what's next !


Thank you !
